# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About GrowToken
Create a free website called "GrowToken". this website is about creating Video Ranking for platform like Youtube shorts, instagram Reels and Tiktok. the website need to be include with high download qulity after creating the video. Also adding Text to the video and even colors, sizes, fonts, bolt and many more. More over this website need to copy every link without a problem. 
To sum up the website should like similar to this Two websites to be more proffesional https://viblo.ai/ and https://www.viewmax.io/
